_doc: Codex & Karmic Carryover (#12) rules and tuning knobs. Design: design/gdd/codex-karmic-carryover.md. realm_karma and heir_cost are indexed by realm_index (0 = Luyện Khí .. 4 = Hóa Thần).

books.name: Đan & Khí Phương (Recipes)
books.seen_when: A recipe is shown or found.
books.effect: Known recipes appear in the craft list from day one; materials, skill and odds stay unchanged.

books.name: Bí Cảnh & Bí Mật (Secrets & Hidden Places)
books.effect: Known: lore and candidate regions/sites as rumours (never this game's rolled site).

books.name: Nhân Vật Chí (Fixed Cast)
books.effect: Profile (name, sect, known traits) and fates across past lives.

books.name: Cổ Sử (World History)
books.known_when: A hidden chronicle entry is uncovered.
books.effect: Learned history and uncovered hidden annals readable from the start.

books.name: Công Pháp (Techniques)
books.effect: Requirements and description; never the manual itself.

books.name: Danh Bảo (Named Items)
books.effect: Requirements and description; never the item itself.

books.name: Ký Lục Kiếp Trước (Lives)
books.effect: Epitaph, chronicle summary, realm, age and cause of death of every life.
